Character origins 字源

A quick note: These stories are here to help a character stick. They are not something to study or memorize. When you are just starting, focus on the word itself: its sound, its meaning, and how to write it. Use an origin only when it makes the character easier to remember, and skip it whenever it feels like one more thing to learn.
